helper_wait_for_ssm() {
  instance_id=$1
  attempt=1
  while [ "$attempt" -le 60 ]; do
    ping=$(aws ssm describe-instance-information \
      --region "$AWS_REGION" \
      --filters "Key=InstanceIds,Values=$instance_id" \
      --query 'InstanceInformationList[0].PingStatus' \
      --output text)
    [ "$ping" = "Online" ] && return 0
    sleep 10
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
  done
  helper_fail "SSM did not become online for $instance_id within 10 minutes"
}
